steps.content: Ring... Ring... Dong...
What's the noise? It sounds like... some rocks clashing together, and someone's talking.
You open your eyes, only to be blinded by the dazzling light, which takes you a while to get used to.
Gems that are fit to be heirlooms of nobles form a beaded curtain, behind which stand some gemstone statues, making the whole room looking extremely luxurious and magnificent.
You aren't tied up, but you seem to have been drugged and don't have any strength. It'll probably take some time before the drug wears off.

steps.speaker: Male Voice
steps.content: You wake up.
Your gaze follows the sound and finds a well-dressed middle-aged man admiring the gemstone statues, who is surrounded by a group of servants in black. This face...
Councilor, why did you kidnap me to this place?

steps.speaker: Councilor
steps.content: Be patient. Our host will be here very soon.
A series of footsteps ring out outside the room. Chelsea enters the room under the "escort" of another group of people.

steps.speaker: Chelsea
steps.content: What did you do to the Chief? And I don't remember giving anyone the key to the underground collection room of the Countess' Court. How did you guys get in?
Chelsea's face is icy and filled with hatred, the same as when she heard the old Count's name in the interrogation room. Despite being taken here by force, she fires a series of questions fearlessly.

steps.speaker: Councilor
steps.content: Come on, Your Excellency, don't be so mad. This is a gift I especially prepared for you.

steps.speaker: Chelsea
steps.content: What gift?

steps.speaker: Councilor
steps.content: Everyone in Eastside knows that the Countess owns mountains of gold and silver passed down from generations, and more gems than she can ever spend. But I also happen to know that the Countess has the ability to turn things into gems.

steps.speaker: Chelsea
steps.content: You want money?

steps.speaker: Councilor
steps.content: Oh, money isn't secure. Unlike gems. Gems are great, I like gems. But of course, what I like better... is the status and influence of the Countess. If Your Excellency is willing to help, basically I'll be able to secure the council's top position.

steps.speaker: Councilor
steps.content: And rest assured, I'll treat you fair after this. I'll give you some of my privileges. I'm sure you know very well—money and power, you can't have one without the other.

steps.speaker: Councilor
steps.content: Here's a gift to show my sincerity, Your Excellency... I heard this person is very stubborn. If it weren't for him, you would've returned to freedom enjoying your life now. You must be very eager to put an end to this yourself, right?
steps.female_content: Here's a gift to show my sincerity, Your Excellency... I heard this person is very stubborn. If it weren't for her, you would've returned to freedom enjoying your life now. You must be very eager to put an end to this yourself, right?

steps.content: Chelsea purses her lips tightly while anger almost bursts out from her eyes as she speaks with gritted teeth.

steps.speaker: Chelsea
steps.content: You have offended me, and I reject your offer. The Chief is very important to me. Don't you dare even lay a finger on him!
steps.female_content: You have offended me, and I reject your offer. The Chief is very important to me. Don't you dare even lay a finger on her!

steps.content: The councilor raises an eyebrow and puts on an eerie smile while maintaining his relaxed manner.

steps.speaker: Councilor
steps.content: Well then, let me propose something else.
As he speaks, he points his chin toward you, then the servant next to you instantly places a dagger in front of your neck.

steps.speaker: Chelsea
steps.content: Chief!

You try to use the shackles, but the servant immediately presses down the dagger, which slits through your neck skin. Blood slowly dribbles down. Seeing this, Chelsea no longer dares to move, glaring at the dagger on your neck, her fists clenching.

steps.speaker: Councilor
steps.content: I'll buy your loyalty with this one's life. What do you think? It's a pretty good deal, right?
At hearing his words, Chelsea's body stiffens as she turns around.
You try to break free and stop Chelsea, but the residual effects of the drug allow you but slight movements, which only deepens the wound on your neck.

steps.speaker: Councilor
steps.content: Come. To our collaboration.
The councilor ignores you and extends his hand to Chelsea, looking very confident, while Chelsea only smiles.
She walks up to him with her head down, grabs his hand—and bursts out laughing.

steps.speaker: Councilor
steps.content: What's so funny?

steps.speaker: Chelsea
steps.content: I'm laughing at you, who has no fear for Sinners.

steps.speaker: Councilor
steps.content: No one will be afraid of a Sinner who can turn stones into gems. Besides, I have a "gift" here to keep you in check, haven't I?

steps.speaker: Councilor
steps.content: You're unlike those barbarians in Syndicate, who only know how to fight and kill.

steps.speaker: Councilor
steps.content: You're a tame cat.

steps.speaker: Chelsea
steps.content: Hahaha... Hahaha... Ah! I can't hold it in anymore! I'm too pleased.
Frenzy shines in her eyes, the kind of shine only from Sinners when they reveal their true nature—dangerous, yet fascinating.

steps.speaker: Councilor
steps.content: Are you pleased with this gift I've got for you?

steps.speaker: Chelsea
steps.content: No, I just think your joke is brilliant. I haven't heard such a funny joke in a long time.

steps.speaker: Chelsea
steps.content: Let me think... The last time I heard a joke like this was when someone wanted to buy my loyalty at the cost of a cat.

steps.speaker: Chelsea
steps.content: That cat was the only thing I could rely on.
Chelsea pauses while the councilor frowns, sensing that something doesn't sound right.

steps.speaker: Chelsea
steps.content: Do you know what happened to that person in the end?
Chelsea's head jerks up, murderous rage pouring out from her like a beast that devours. The councilor tries to withdraw his hand, but it's too late.

steps.speaker: Councilor
steps.content: Wh-What are you doing...!!
From where the hands touch, human skin is quickly replaced by shiny gems.

steps.speaker: Councilor
steps.content: The price... can be... negotiated...
Within the length of a breath, the smug councilor has turned into a gem statue with a distorted face, just like the countless statues around him.
Everyone is stunned by what just happened before them. After a few seconds, a terrified scream shatters the silence. The councilor's men start to flee toward the door in terror.

steps.speaker: Chelsea
steps.content: Heh..heh, I thought you guys like gems? Here, take them!
With Chelsea's laughter, a rain of gems flood out, showering down on everyone in the room. A bloody color begins to spread out in the dazzling golden glow.
The person holding the dagger against you lies on the floor, battered and bloodied on the head. It's hard to tell if he's dead or alive.
You try to use every muscle in your body to protect yourself while rushing up to Chelsea with all your strength.
Waves of sharp pain wash over you to stop you and make you fall.
But you keep on moving. You almost can't feel your arms when you touch Chelsea.

She doesn't seem to notice your coming as her fists remain clenched while her nails pierce into her hands and blood trickles from them. She keeps controlling the gem rain robotically, as if she's unaware of any pain.
You grab Chelsea. The patterns of the shackles spread and illuminate the entire collection room with its red beams, instantly devouring the bright glow of gems.
Chelsea's eyes, awakened by the scorching heat, slowly comes into focus. When your eyes meet hers, you see not only anger, but also immense fear and guilt.
When the shackles are completed, Chelsea sits on her knees like a puppet with broken strings.
Chelsea!
You grab Chelsea. The patterns of the shackles spread and illuminate the entire collection room with its red beams, instantly devouring the bright glow of gems.
Chelsea's eyes, awakened by the scorching heat, slowly comes into focus. When your eyes meet hers, you see not only anger, but also immense fear and guilt.
When the shackles are completed, Chelsea sits on her knees like a puppet with broken strings.
Chelsea!

When the shackles are completed, Chelsea sits on her knees like a puppet with broken strings.
Chelsea!
You grab Chelsea. The patterns of the shackles spread and illuminate the entire collection room with its red beams, instantly devouring the bright glow of gems.
Chelsea's eyes, awakened by the scorching heat, slowly comes into focus. When your eyes meet hers, you see not only anger, but also immense fear and guilt.
When the shackles are completed, Chelsea sits on her knees like a puppet with broken strings.
Chelsea!
She pants rapidly and gives no reply, while her gaze remains on her clenched fist.
You bend down and hold Chelsea's face in your hands, forcing her to look at you.
Don't be scared. I'm still alive.

steps.speaker: Chelsea
steps.content: Chi... Chief...
Chelsea's trembling voice is mixed with lingering fear and slight whimper.
It's all fine now.

steps.speaker: Chelsea
steps.content: I... I killed them.
...When we get back, you'll need to write a report with me about what happened.

steps.speaker: Chelsea
steps.content: I... stained the gems... They're stained with the blood of the scoundrels.

steps.speaker: Chelsea
steps.content: And I even... dragged you into it. I said I would be your sugar mama and make you happy, yet you got kidnapped and nearly died because of me.

steps.speaker: Chelsea
steps.content: This is happening again... I failed to protect... I'm sorry... Sorry...

steps.speaker: Chelsea
steps.content: There was a kitten called Sitri who would read and play with me and be there for me on those sleepless nights. It was such a warm cat.

steps.speaker: Chelsea
steps.content: Chelsea bought everything with money—Family, friends, happiness. Sitri was the only exception.

steps.speaker: Chelsea
steps.content: But that old Count! He killed Sitri in front of my eyes to make me listen to him. He pulled out its heart and put it in my hand.

steps.speaker: Chelsea
steps.content: For a moment just now... I felt as if my hands were full of Sitri's blood, as if I was holding Sitri's heart... As if its heart was still beating.

steps.speaker: Chelsea
steps.content: It's my fault. It's my fault... that I couldn't protect it.
Chelsea opens her hands, on which is the blood trace where her nails just pierced.
Tears stream down her face, and you can feel every cell in her body screaming and wailing.
But you protected me with your gems. If it weren't for you, I would probably be dead by now.
Chelsea's hand is as cold as gems.
No, it's not you and the gems that are dirty. It's the malicious scoundrels. The gems are beautiful, and so are you.
But even the coldest gem will gradually be warmed up by the warmth of another pair of hands.
Thank you, Chelsea.
Chelsea's eyes light up like bright, shining gems.

steps.speaker: Chelsea
steps.content: So... Can I still be your sugar mama, Chief?
...You're in the mood to joke around now?

steps.speaker: Chelsea
steps.content: I'm being serious! I really do want to be your sugar mama. I'll give you my gems! And this castle!
I prefer having a companion I can trust to those gems and castles.
Let's fight together and entrust our lives to each other. Isn't this a companionship a million times better than having sugar babies?
Let's go. We've got to report back to the Bureau and get someone to take care of the rest. The Bureau must be in a real mess.
Chelsea, pondering, does as you say, and you return to the MBCC together.
A few days later...
After your returning from the Countess' Court, the MBCC has been unsettled with many secretly unhappy with Chelsea, yet not a single person has said anything.
As for why... you lift your head to take a look at the Chief's office, which is much more luxurious than before. Even the drinking water has been replaced with the most expensive brand.
There's only one answer—money.

steps.speaker: Chelsea
steps.content: Chief! Did anyone bother you today? I've got it all taken care of.

steps.speaker: Chelsea
steps.content: By the way, after a few days of thinking, it has finally dawned on me.

steps.speaker: Chelsea
steps.content: Being your sugar mama doesn't contradict fighting along with you! So...

steps.speaker: Chelsea
steps.content: Come on, Chief, at least give it some more thought!

steps.speaker: Chelsea
steps.content: I'll buy you nice things, and I'll tell you stories too!
Chelsea still doesn't want to give up asking you to be her sugar baby. You let out a long sigh and give her a resigned look. Never mind. Just let her be and call it even.
I still have to work. Please be quiet.
Chelsea's voice trailed off.

steps.speaker: Chelsea
steps.content: Once upon a time, there was a gem princess in the forest. She had a great companion who fought alongside her...
